project_name.justification: The acquisition by Eureka Lithium Corp. includes three districts, one of which is the project of interest: "Raglan West District - 443 sq. km claim block".

company_name.justification: The acquiring company changed its name upon completion of the acquisition. "Eureka Lithium Corp. (formerly Scout Minerals Corp.) (CSE:ERKA) (formerly SCTM)) (“Eureka” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce... that it has completed the acquisition..."

ceo_buyer.justification: Mr. Jeffrey Wilson, Eureka CEO, commented: "We are pleased to complete this important property asset acquisition and concurrent financing."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company acquired a 100% interest in the land package. "Eureka has acquired from vendors, including Shawn Ryan, 100% of a 1,408 sq. km land package..."

primary_commodity.justification: The press release describes the acquired property as being prospective for lithium. "...completed the acquisition of a large-scale land package prospective for spodumene-bearing lithium pegmatites..."

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source documents.

currency.justification: The cash consideration is listed in dollars and the acquiring company is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE), implying Canadian Dollars. "...in exchange for $1,200,000 in cash..." and "The Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE) has not reviewed, approved, or disapproved the contents of this press release."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The project's share is $400,000, calculated as one-third of the total $1,200,000 cash consideration for the three-district package (Raglan West, Raglan South, and New Leaf). The text states the total consideration for the package: "Eureka has acquired from vendors... 100% of a 1,408 sq. km land package covering Raglan West, Raglan South and New Leaf District... in exchange for $1,200,000 in cash..."

share_payments_raw.justification: The deal involved 8,000,000 shares, but a monetary value for these shares was not provided as part of the consideration terms.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the deal were listed separately, not as a combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The project's share is 2,666,667 shares (rounded from 2,666,666.67), calculated as one-third of the total 8,000,000 shares issued for the three-district package (Raglan West, Raglan South, and New Leaf). The text states the total share consideration for the package: "Eureka has acquired from vendors... 100% of a 1,408 sq. km land package covering Raglan West, Raglan South and New Leaf District... in exchange for ... 8,000,000 common shares of the Company..."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No warrants were mentioned as part of the acquisition consideration. Warrants were part of a separate concurrent financing, not payment for the property.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the acquisition consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The price of the 8,000,000 consideration shares was not specified in the acquisition terms.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in meters was mentioned in the acquisition terms.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The acquisition terms did not include a specific exploration spending commitment. A financing was raised for exploration, but this was not a commitment to the vendor as part of the acquisition.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The deal included the vendor retaining a royalty on the properties. "...and the grant of a 1% net smelter return (NSR) royalty."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The total acquisition covered 1,408 sq. km across three districts, but the area specific to the Raglan West project is explicitly stated: "Raglan West District - 443 sq. km claim block".

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified in the text: "Raglan West District - 443 sq. km claim block".

resource_size.justification: The text mentions historically mapped pegmatites and high lithium values in lake sediments, but does not provide a quantified mineral resource estimate (e.g., tonnes, ounces).

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's name and ticker are provided in the June 1, 2023 news release: "Eureka Lithium Corp. (formerly Scout Minerals Corp.) (CSE:ERKA)".
